entry.title: Presented our evolutionary perspective on CISP at SESJ26

link.title: Presented our evolutionary perspective on CISP at SESJ26

entry.content: We have presented on the 28th Annual Meeting of the Society of Evolutionary Studies, Japan that has been conducted at Nagoya University. We participated at the poster session presenting our newest finding on how Poaceae modify CISP protein specifically as a responses for cold stress.

entry.title: SESJ26 で P23k 研究成果を発表しました

link.title: SESJ26 で P23k 研究成果を発表しました

entry.content:
第28回日本進化学会大会でも、P23kに関する研究成果を発表しました！タンパク質ファミリー内でのアミノ酸配列の相同性が低いにもかかわらず、P23kがいかにして似た構造をとり得るかについてお話ししました。
We also presented our results on P23k at the 28th Annual Meeting of the Society of Evolutionary Studies! We talked about how P23k can have a similar structure despite sharing fewer amino acid sequences within the protein family.
